A separate direct permutation enumeration verified all 1099 simple graphs on one to five vertices and their 124469 relative orders, while marked-edge canonical relabelling establishes the three positive orbits (60,120,60). The infinite formula is analytic, not inferred from finite checks.

value.rationale: Edge addition is a natural increase in exclusion constraints, so the direction of ultimate random adsorption occupancy is structurally significant. The theorem gives a complete priority coupling and output law exhibiting a strict positive response across all star–clique parameters m>=2, alongside a negative response for m=1. The exhaustive five-vertex boundary is the first possible failure of edge-monotonicity, unique to three marked graph classes, with connected sources included; this is a motivated exact boundary, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
